name: UV Volumes Framework
definition: A real-time free-view video synthesis method that encodes low-frequency semantic information in smooth 3D UV volumes and high-frequency appearance in a 2D neural texture stack (NTS), enabling pose, shape, and texture editing.
summary: The UV Volumes Framework is a real-time free-view video synthesis method that decouples geometry and appearance using time-invariant 3D UV volumes and a 2D Neural Texture Stack for explicit editing.
